name: Ennis Fine Furniture- Boise
old_description: Celebrating 80 Years — Ennis Fine Furniture, Family Owned Since 1946
about:
Ennis Fine Furniture was founded in 1946 in Boise, Idaho, when World War II veteran Cecil Ennis and his brother-in-law purchased a former horse stable at 23rd Street and Fairview Avenue and converted it into a furniture and appliance store. The business has remained family-owned for nearly eight decades, passing from Cecil to his son Dick Ennis in 1968 and now to the third generation—grandchildren Rick, Jeff, and Cathy—who continue to operate the company today.

The retailer operates two showrooms, in Boise and Spokane, Washington, offering living-room, bedroom, and dining-room collections that include sofas, sectionals, chairs, tables, beds, dressers, and cabinetry. Ennis Fine Furniture positions itself as a destination for semi-custom and luxury furnishings, providing design consultation to help clients select finishes, stains, and configurations. The company also handles delivery, installation, and haul-away of old furniture.

Its customer base consists primarily of residential homeowners throughout the Pacific Northwest. Testimonials cite purchases ranging from dining tables and floor lamps to complete family-room sets, with clients emphasizing the personalized attention from named design consultants such as John Ambrose, Mary Ann, and Patti.

The company attributes its longevity to its family-legacy values—trust, loyalty, and a personalized experience—rather than mass-market trends. As the ownership states, the goal is not only to provide handcrafted furniture but to ensure every step of the journey is met with care and attention, making the purchase an investment in a piece of history and artistry.
